title: Ok
text: Ok. This item is just ok. I purchased it because it says it can fit a man's size 13 shoe. Well I ended up using it for my toddler son's shoe and I couldn't even fit both of his shoes in 1 pocket. Slimmer shoes like sandals I could but not sneakers. Wish I would have known this prior to purchasing.....
